_doc: interrupting = sustained mutual speech (server/watch/vectors.py interrupting_events; apps/mobile/src/live/nudgePolicy.ts interruptingEvents). Turns are [start,end] seconds. Replayed by server/tests/watch/test_vectors.py and apps/mobile/__tests__/liveInterruptingVectors.test.ts.

cases.name: brief overlap at a speaker change is normal (no event)
self starts 1.0 s before the other ends: still normal
2.0 s of mutual speech -> level 1 (t = self start, value = overlap)
self keeps going 6 s+ while the other is still talking -> level 3
self ends first: overlap is bounded by self's own end (3 s -> level 1)
self did not start inside the other's turn (the other cut in): no event about self
two others both talked over: one event per other turn self started inside
exact boundary: starting AT the other's end is not inside it
